name: PBK Brain Hypothesis Registry
purpose: Single machine-readable inventory of canonical strategies, research hypotheses and decision-model work. Registry metadata is governance-only and never creates a bet, value claim or exposure by itself.

status_meanings.IDEA: Defined work item; may have data, but validation has not started.
status_meanings.HIST_TESTED: Historical evaluation executed; result not yet accepted as passed.
status_meanings.PASSED: Required historical/OOS gate passed for the explicitly stated scope only.
status_meanings.REVIEW: Forward evidence is ready for manual governance review.
status_meanings.PAUSED: Retained for traceability but not active.

global_guardrails: Discussed is not done: an item advances only when the evidence required for that status exists.
Data collected is not the same as a working metric; a metric computed is not the same as a validated hypothesis; a validated hypothesis is not the same as value today.
Historical results are never backfilled into the clean forward journal.
Context and historical patterns are explanatory-only until separately validated.
Probability/value output is separate from canonical strategy authority.
No fabricated probability, xG, xA, lineup, injury, referee or transfer evidence.
Eligibility and execution remain separate layers.
Same fixture/market/selection must not create duplicate exposure.
Quarter Asian handicap lines are not required for final user recommendations; prefer executable half-lines where applicable.
League applicability must be validated at the league level; pooled evidence does not prove every constituent league.
League scope cannot expand beyond config/pbk_competition_scope.json without explicit project-owner decision.

validation_protocol.principle: A visually interesting pattern is evidence to test, not a betting rule.

hypotheses.label: Serie A away unique minimum favourite
hypotheses.idea: Serie A away unique minimum favourite
hypotheses.definition: Serie A only; away team is unique minimum Bet365 1X2 favourite; 1.20 <= B365A < 2.10; P2; 1u.
guardrails: Do not broaden league scope.
Do not alter odds band through UI filters.

hypotheses.label: Serie A R1 plus last-five PPG advantage
hypotheses.idea: Serie A R1 plus last-five PPG advantage
hypotheses.definition: All R1 conditions; both teams have at least 5 previous current-season league matches; away last5 PPG > home last5 PPG; P2; 1u.
guardrails: Do not broaden league scope.
Use only previous matches for last-five form.

hypotheses.label: Big-5 Monday late-season draw
hypotheses.definition: Big-5 only; Monday in local league calendar; both teams have <=10 league matches remaining including current match; X; 1u.
guardrails: Never backfill the historical 155 bets into the clean forward ledger.

hypotheses.label: Generic 1X2 Probability v1
hypotheses.idea: Calibrate Bet365 no-vig 1X2 probabilities and test whether the frozen adjustment improves probability quality.
filters: first complete valid prematch observation only
hypotheses.definition: Frozen market-calibration model: historical OOS evidence passed only on the pooled Big-5 sample; prospective validation is independent per league across all 16 locked leagues.
guardrails: Historical pooled Big-5 PASS is not league-specific validation.
Each league receives its own forward review.
No historical backfill.
No EV/value, stake, R1/R2/R3, production or canonical authority from this model.

evidence_refs.forward_scope: 16 leagues; official verdict per league only

hypotheses.label: Historical H2H with home/away orientation
hypotheses.definition: Evaluate same home-team vs same away-team historical meetings separately from reverse venue, including sample size, recency, season spread and deviation from each team's ordinary home/away baseline.
guardrails: Never infer certainty from H2H alone.
Expose sample size and recency.
Compare against team baseline before calling a pattern unusual.

hypotheses.label: Long-horizon team home/away profile
hypotheses.definition: Measure team home and away performance by season and rolling multi-season windows, with opponent-strength/price context where available.
guardrails: Recent seasons and old seasons must remain distinguishable.

hypotheses.label: Weekday and kickoff-time effects
hypotheses.definition: Test weekday and kickoff-time effects without assuming Monday/Thursday or any clock window is universally predictive.
guardrails: Pre-register buckets before evaluating them.

hypotheses.label: Rest days and compressed schedule
hypotheses.definition: Test rest-day differences, midweek load and compressed schedules using only information known before kickoff.
guardrails: No future fixture/result leakage.

hypotheses.label: Domestic cup and European-match load
hypotheses.definition: Test performance after/before domestic cups and UEFA matches, including Thursday/midweek effects, without assigning a universal penalty to any named club.
guardrails: Club-specific examples never become universal rules without evidence.

hypotheses.label: Season stage and objective/consequence context
hypotheses.definition: Measure late-round/table-consequence effects from standings facts, not unverifiable psychology.
guardrails: Only prior finished matches may alter later pre-kickoff context.

hypotheses.label: Favourite and underdog price-band behaviour
hypotheses.definition: Test favourite and underdog outcomes by pre-registered odds bands, including large-price opponents, with ROI and drawdown rather than hit-rate alone.
guardrails: High odds alone are not value.
Do not introduce a global odds cap.

hypotheses.label: Home favourite P1
hypotheses.definition: Test home-favourite P1 hypotheses by league and price band rather than assuming home favourites are universally profitable.
guardrails: Validate per league.
Large or short price alone is not a signal.
Do not infer value before a validated probability model exists.

hypotheses.label: Away favourite P2
hypotheses.definition: Test general away-favourite P2 hypotheses by league and price band separately from locked R1/R2.
guardrails: Validate per league.
Large or short price alone is not a signal.
Do not infer value before a validated probability model exists.

hypotheses.label: Draw X
hypotheses.definition: Test draw hypotheses by league, price regime and context separately from locked R3.
guardrails: Validate per league.
Large or short price alone is not a signal.
Do not infer value before a validated probability model exists.

hypotheses.label: Underdog win
hypotheses.definition: Test outright underdog wins where pre-match evidence can justify the larger price.
guardrails: Validate per league.
Large or short price alone is not a signal.
Do not infer value before a validated probability model exists.

hypotheses.label: Against an overvalued favourite
hypotheses.definition: Test whether a favourite is overpriced and whether the opponent/draw side has independent positive evidence.
guardrails: Validate per league.
Large or short price alone is not a signal.
Do not infer value before a validated probability model exists.

hypotheses.label: Large-price longshot
hypotheses.definition: Test large-price outcomes only when independent probability/value evidence exists; large odds alone never qualify.
guardrails: Validate per league.
Large or short price alone is not a signal.
Do not infer value before a validated probability model exists.

hypotheses.label: Over/under totals hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Develop and validate O/U hypotheses across executable lines instead of ignoring totals.
guardrails: Validate each line/selection separately.

hypotheses.label: BTTS / No-BTTS hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Maintain BTTS research/forward evidence separately from canonical exposure.
guardrails: WATCH never increases canonical exposure.

hypotheses.label: Team-total hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Develop ITB/ITM hypotheses with explicit team, line, side and price.
guardrails: No recommendation without an executable market line/price.

hypotheses.label: Executable half-line handicap hypotheses
hypotheses.definition: Validate executable half-line handicaps suitable for the user's bookmaker constraints.
guardrails: Do not substitute unavailable quarter-lines into final recommendations.

hypotheses.label: Draw No Bet / zero handicap
hypotheses.definition: Develop and validate DNB/F0 hypotheses independently from 1X2 probabilities.
guardrails: Capture availability is not strategy validation.
Push outcome must be handled explicitly.

hypotheses.label: Double chance
hypotheses.definition: Develop and validate 1X, X2 and 12 independently with their own prices and probabilities.
guardrails: Do not derive a betting decision merely by adding unvalidated 1X2 probabilities.

hypotheses.label: European handicap
hypotheses.definition: Develop and validate European handicap selections as distinct multi-outcome markets.
guardrails: Do not treat European handicap as Asian handicap.

hypotheses.label: Asian handicap
hypotheses.definition: Develop and validate Asian handicap variants separately by line and settlement semantics.
guardrails: Final user recommendations should prefer executable half-lines where quarter-lines are unavailable.
Push/half-win/half-loss semantics must never be conflated.

hypotheses.label: Player Overall Grade
hypotheses.definition: Research player-quality grade from strictly pre-kickoff or prior-match evidence.
guardrails: No look-ahead player performance.
Research grade cannot mutate canonical strategy eligibility.

hypotheses.label: Player Form Grade
hypotheses.definition: Build separate Last/Form3/Form5/Form10/Season player form views with trend and opponent/home-away context.
guardrails: Do not equate a short hot streak with stable player quality.

hypotheses.label: Player Importance
hypotheses.definition: Estimate player importance from historical role, starts, minutes, quality, replacement and team-with/without evidence without inventing missing inputs.
guardrails: Missing evidence remains null/unknown.
Small with/without samples require shrinkage or explicit uncertainty.

hypotheses.label: Starting-XI Quality
hypotheses.definition: Aggregate expected/confirmed XI quality from player grades and importance, preserving expected-vs-confirmed distinction.
guardrails: Confirmed XI must never be backfilled into a timestamp when it was not yet known.

hypotheses.label: Rotation impact
hypotheses.definition: Measure lineup turnover and quality delta versus a pre-match baseline XI/core, including positional/core changes and schedule context.
guardrails: Separate ordinary rotation from confirmed absence evidence.

hypotheses.label: Legacy combined absence/return hypothesis
hypotheses.definition: Legacy umbrella retained for traceability; new work is split into ABSENCE_IMPACT and RETURN_IMPACT.
guardrails: Do not resume this combined hypothesis; use the split IDs.

hypotheses.label: Verified absence impact
hypotheses.definition: Test the effect of verified player absences using player importance, replacement quality, positions and XI structural change.
guardrails: No injury/absence claim without verified pre-kickoff evidence.

hypotheses.label: Verified player return impact
hypotheses.definition: Test the effect of a verified key-player return, expected minutes and replacement displacement rather than assuming any return is positive.
guardrails: No return claim without verified pre-kickoff evidence.
Account for expected minutes and role.

hypotheses.label: Team Grades
hypotheses.definition: Build separate Attack, Defence, Form, Home, Away, Schedule/Fatigue, Squad, XI, Availability, Motivation/Objectives and Market grades; do not blindly average into one score.
guardrails: Each component needs its own evidence and confidence.
Overall grade is not authorized until aggregation is validated.

hypotheses.label: Style and matchup grade
hypotheses.definition: Test style interactions such as press vs weak build-up, set pieces, tempo vs fatigue, wing mismatch, low block, aerial play and transitions.
guardrails: A matchup narrative is not evidence until features and outcomes are defined.

hypotheses.label: Referee disciplinary and team-interaction context
hypotheses.definition: Test referee cards, reds, penalties, draws and team-specific history with sample-size and recency controls.
guardrails: Do not label bias from anecdotal or tiny samples.

hypotheses.label: Weather context
hypotheses.definition: Preserve pre-kickoff weather as context and validate predictive value separately.
guardrails: Context alone cannot mutate canonical eligibility.

hypotheses.label: Market movement and closing-line evidence
hypotheses.definition: Measure open/current/pre-close/closing movement, direction, speed, magnitude and CLV only when timestamped prices actually exist.
guardrails: CLV remains empty when no closing price exists.
Movement is context/evidence, not automatic value.

hypotheses.label: High probability is separate from high value
hypotheses.idea: High probability is separate from high value
hypotheses.definition: Keep probability ranking and value ranking separate: a short price is not automatically safe or valuable.
guardrails: Never label a bet value without market-specific validated probability and executable price.

hypotheses.label: Longshot / underdog opportunity logic
hypotheses.definition: Search for underdog/large-price opportunities when the market may overvalue the favourite and independent PBK evidence supports the opposing side.
guardrails: Big odds alone are never a signal.
Require market-specific probability/value before recommendation.

hypotheses.label: Full supported-market scanner
hypotheses.definition: For each match enumerate all available supported selections before choosing an alternative; availability does not imply a validated model.
guardrails: Return NO_VALIDATED_MODEL for unsupported probability families.
Do not stop scanning because one canonical signal exists.

hypotheses.label: Validated probability/value across supported markets
hypotheses.definition: Compare calibrated PBK probability with no-vig market probability and executable price, market by market.
guardrails: Return NO_VALIDATED_MODEL rather than fabricate probability.
High probability is not equivalent to value.
Never transfer probability from one bet/market to another.

hypotheses.label: Cross-market PBK Decision Engine
hypotheses.definition: Rank independently validated market opportunities using probability, executable value and evidence layers while preserving canonical strategy authority.
guardrails: No automatic canonical promotion.
Explain why, probability/value evidence and minimum acceptable executable price.
Conflicting hypotheses must remain visible.
